title: Decision: Member::commit adds the record change and the required Removes by itself
description:
draft-atwood-mls-didwebvh-credential-00 §Expected Heads: "A Commit that changes the expected value MUST therefore include a GroupContextExtensions proposal that sets it", and §Rules: the Commit that raises a head must remove the leaves it no longer authorizes.

mimid API choice (not a spec ambiguity): Member::commit computes the expected record from the epoch it is about to create, and if it differs from what the Commit would set, or leaves are no longer authorized, it clears the staged Commit and stages it again with the GroupContextExtensions proposal and the Removes added (up to three rounds; removing leaves never changes the expected record). A caller revoking a device therefore needs only to give the device's identity the new credential and commit. It refuses (DidWebvhError::CommitterUnauthorized) when the record would no longer authorize the committer, (AddedUnauthorized) when a leaf it adds is not authorized, and (PendingGroupContextExtensions) when a GroupContextExtensions proposal is already pending (Open Issue 5). The `apply` callback for AppDataUpdate proposals may therefore be called more than once per Commit. Every Commit mimid sends is also checked with the receiver's check (didwebvh::check_staged) before it is returned.
